datasets.name: ODSAccounts
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  A.ID,
  A.ACC_NO,
  SUBSTR(acc_no,(select value from settings where name='AccNoSearchPos'),30) as ACC_No_Search,
  A.VAL_ACC,
  A.NAME
 
FROM
  ACCOUNT A

WHERE
 
 
  A.CLOSE_DAT IS NULL
 
ORDER BY ACC_NO_SEARCH

datasets.name: ODSBankInfo

where bankcode is not null
and ours=1

datasets.name: ODSBankM
datasets.sql:
/*Select
    *
From
  BankM

Order by Name
*/

select null as id, null as krno, null as name, null as inn, null as swift,null as bankcode,null as subkrno,
       null as bank_kod,null as license_date,null as tax_regcode,null as ours,null as val_code from dual

Select* From   BankM a

datasets.name: ODSArchive
datasets.sql:
Select
  id
 ,pdate
 ,pnum
 ,dbname
 ,dbcod
 ,dbinn
 ,dbcoracc
 ,dbswift
 ,dacc_no
 ,daccname
 ,daccinn
 ,kbname
 ,kbcod
 ,kbinn
 ,kbcoracc
 ,kbswift
 ,kacc_no
 ,kaccname
 ,kaccinn
 ,to_char(ammount) ammount
 ,assignment
 ,extra
,MOD_BANK
,budgetclass
,budgetlevel
,VAL_NAME


From
 PaymentDecree
where PDate between :begdat and :enddat

Order by
  :Title

datasets.name: Ods_Acc_Vall
datasets.sql: select a.id ,a.val_acc,v.val_name, v.valu_short,v.valu_bala from account a, avalute v where a.val_acc=v.valute and a.acc_no=:acc_no

datasets.name: ODS_Acc_symbol
datasets.sql:
select a.acc_no,a.old_acc_no as old, s.symbol,s.old_acc_no from account a,account_symbols s where a.symb=s.symbol
 and s.old_acc_no=1
 and a.acc_no=:acc_no

datasets.name: Ds_Acoount
datasets.sql:
select * from account a , customers c
where a.close_dat is null and a.kli_id=c.id

datasets.name: Ds_Inv_child
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,a.* from invoices_child a
where inv_id = :INV_ID order by id

datasets.name: Ds_Inv_Archive
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,a.id,a.pdate,a.dbname,a.dbcod,a.dbinn,a.dbswift,a.dacc_no,a.kbname,a.kbinn,a.kacc_no,a.num,
a.prescription,a.col1,a.col2,a.col3,a.col4,a.col5,a.sumamount from invoices a order by id desc

datasets.name: ds
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,a.id,a.pdate,a.dbname,a.dbcod,a.dbinn,a.dbswift,a.dacc_no,a.kbname,a.kbinn,
(select acc_no from account where id=a.kacc_no)as kacc_no,a.num,a.prescription,a.col1,a.col2,
a.col3,a.col4,a.col5,a.sumamount from invoices a where a.id=:pid order by id desc

datasets.name: ds2
datasets.sql:
select sum(col2)as cemi_col2,(sum(col2)*0.18) as EDV_col2,(sum(col2) +(sum(col2)*0.18)) as yekun_col2,
sum(col3)as cemi_col3,(sum(col3)*0.18) as EDV_col3,(sum(col3) +(sum(col3)*0.18)) as yekun_col3,
sum(col4)as cemi_col4,(sum(col4)*0.18) as EDV_col4,(sum(col4) +(sum(col4)*0.18)) as yekun_col4,
((sum(col2) +(sum(col2)*0.18))+ (sum(col3) +(sum(col3)*0.18))+(sum(col4) +(sum(col4)*0.18))) as sum_all_yekun 
from invoices_child where inv_id =:pid

datasets.name: ODS_PNUM
datasets.sql:
select nvl(max(pnum)+1,1) as pnum from paymentdecree_t
where to_char(pdate, 'YYYY')=(select to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY') from dual)
